newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Baer slashes Swiss Life earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Baer slashes Swiss Life earnings forecast.

text.p: Bank Julius Baer said it had cut its earnings forecast for Swiss Life/Rentenanstalt and downgraded its rating for the insurer's participation certificates to underperform from market performance.

"The management's expectations regarding the share in profit (to be published) due to all the future shareholders from the annual surplus were considerably below our previous estimates," Baer said in its latest Market View Switzerland.
It downgraded its rating to C from B, indicating it expected the certificates to underperform the broader Swiss market.
It cut its 1996 earnings per share forecast to 12.8 francs from 20.8 and its 1997 view to 9.4 from 25.6.

Swiss Life plans to convert into a public limited company from its present form of cooperative. Holders of participation certificates will vote on February 20 whether to convert the voting certificates into share capital.
Certificates were trading at 460 francs, down 50 centimes.
